source_corrections: Shen equation (2.3) mixes i and k in the direct-sum display; notes consistently use k.
Shifted perverse summands are distinguished from objects in the perverse heart; 0M01 is used only in that heart.
Positive-degree coprime Higgs moduli use the twisted Betti relation, not the ordinary zero-Chern local-system correspondence.
Higgs normalized ch removes only the pure H2(C) and H2(M) components, not the H1(C) tensor H1(M) part.
Universal-Jacobian counterexample is existential, g>=4 and n=1, as a graded algebra over the base cohomology ring.
Stability formula includes non-locally-free boundary-node correction; scalar automorphisms are rigidified before claiming the moduli is DM.
0J01/0J02 foundations were split into constructible sheaf 0J1J and hypercohomology 0J1K; mapping cone reuses 019R.
